stem: Under RA 7438, a person who is arrested, detained or under custodial investigation shall at all times be assisted by whom?
choices: A police officer of his choice
hints: RA 7438 protects people held or questioned by the authorities. Think of who protects a suspect's rights during questioning.
Recall Section 2(a) of RA 7438. It names one person who must assist "at all times".
Section 2(b) says the investigating officer must provide this same person if the suspect "cannot afford" one. Match that person to the choices.

solution.methodName: Recall the exact words of the provision

steps.action: It says the person "shall at all times be assisted by counsel."
Section 2(b) adds: "If such person cannot afford the services of his own counsel, he must be provided with a competent and independent counsel by the investigating officer."
steps.why: So being poor is no reason to go without a lawyer.

steps.action: Family members may visit under Section 2(f), but the law does not make them the ones who assist during questioning.

trapNotes.A police officer of his choice: A police officer is on the investigating side. Section 2(a) says the person must be assisted by counsel.
trapNotes.A barangay official: A barangay official is not named in Section 2(a). The law requires counsel, meaning a lawyer.
trapNotes.A member of his family: Family may visit under Section 2(f), but Section 2(a) says the person must be assisted by counsel.
